text:
priya: Morning — multiple customers reporting tool-call failures since ~09:12 UTC. Spike in 4xx on /v1/tools/invoke. Error: 'Malformed tool args'. Tickets INC-485, INC-486. Can SRE/eng triage? :eyes:

deploy-bot: ALERT: tools-invoke-4xx-rate increased to 28% (5m avg) — dashboard https://grafana.redwood/d/xyz

jordan: On it. Linking grafana and recent deploys. Any pattern by model or customer?

priya: Mostly enterprise customers on dedicated capacity. Symptoms: 400 response body includes 'expected object for args, got array' and 'unknown tool name: search' in some cases.

maya: I see a bump in tool-parser service logs starting at 09:11:49 UTC coincident with canary of runtime 2.1.2. Error sample from logs:
```json
{"err":"ValidationError","tool":"web_search","message":"expected object for args, got array","request_id":"req_9a8f"}
```

leo: Model-side mapping changed in evals branch — assistant now returns tool args as positional array in some templates (legacy). That'll break strict schema validation. Did we change function aliasing?

maya: Yes — the parser was hardened to require args be object and tool name must match exactly. Canary got deployed to 3 nodes.

jordan: Can we roll back the canary to stop customer impact?

maya: Rolling back canary now. Also pushing a quick compat shim to coerce args arrays -> objects and accept alias 'search' -> 'web_search' for 24h.

deploy-bot: DEPLOY: rollback runtime-canary-2.1.2 initiated by @maya at 09:27 UTC; status: in_progress

priya: Notifying affected customers and adding repro steps from tickets: sample payload that fails:
```json
{"tools":[{"name":"search","args":["what's the weather in SF?"]}],"model":"assistant-v1"}
```

maya: Confirmed shim accepted that payload; tests green in staging. Hotfix PR: https://git/redwood/pulls/789 — will roll out to hosted and Dedicated next 10m. :white_check_mark:

jordan: Monitoring 4xx rate — dropping from 28% -> 6% over 10m. Keep an eye on 5xx. Set incident tag and notify oncall.

priya: Thanks team. Postmortem: add feature flags for strict validation, better canary gating for parser changes, and e2e tests that include legacy templates. I'll open postmortem doc.

maya: Filed postmortem draft: https://docs.redwood/postmortems/incident-1772004047 — will add action items.
